title: OpenAI Secret API key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: the sk- stem of sk-proj- broken (xk-proj-, not an OpenAI prefix); marker, widths and alphabet unchanged. Twin of "OpenAI Secret API key: must be flagged (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
